title: fix(enter): expose gen API catalog and link documentation directly
author: patbing

gist.summary: Enter adds unauthenticated GET /.well-known/api-catalog, which redirects to the gen API catalog with a permanent, method-preserving 308; production, staging, and development origins map to their corresponding gen origins. OAuth metadata now points service_documentation directly to gen /docs instead of going through enter /api/docs. The existing enter /api/docs redirect remains unchanged, and enter's llms.txt now links to the gen API catalog.
